facts.text: Caroline shared her story with a group of young people at an LGBTQ+ youth center, emphasizing that they are not alone.

evidence.quote: I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story.
I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.

facts.text: Caroline reflected on her own past struggles and felt a connection to the young people she supported at the LGBTQ+ youth center.

evidence.quote: It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone.

facts.text: Caroline expressed a commitment to continue volunteering at the LGBTQ+ youth center and making a difference in the community.

evidence.quote: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there.
I really believe in community and supporting each other. So I wanna keep making a difference.
